CrossCheckSignal.note: The shared generic enumerator walks Swagger `definitions` 1:1 (240) — Constant Contact's Swagger 2.0 spec declares separate DTO variants per resource (e.g. ContactDto/ContactResource/ContactPostRequest/ContactPutRequest/ContactCreateOrUpdateInput/ContactCreateOrUpdateResponse/ContactDelete are all shape-variants of ONE resource: Contact). This vendor's bespoke path-by-tag walker (enumerate-taxonomy.mjs) instead enumerates ADDRESSABLE RESOURCES (paths grouped by OpenAPI tag, collapsing multi-verb/multi-shape operations on the same path down to one leaf) — the correct unit for a REST API's syncable-table universe. 240 DTO-variants / 67 resources ≈ 3.6 variants-per-resource, a plausible ratio (Create/Update/Response/Delete/List variants), not a red flag. Both counts are reported; 240 is retained purely as an independent upper-bound sanity signal, not as TaxonomyLeaves.

FullUniverseAccounting.ledger: |E|=76 == |COVERABLE (TaxonomyLeaves)|=67 + |out-of-scope-route (Gaps, named+evidenced)|=9 + |INFORMATIONAL|=0 (informational taxonomies — OAuth2/rate-limits/pagination/error-codes — are NOT path/resource nodes so were never part of E) + |container-folded|=0 (OpenAPI tags are not L1 containers over a deeper leaf layer for a REST API; a path IS a leaf) + |excluded-scaffolding|=0 (no test fixtures/dead folders found in this vendor's public OpenAPI).
